{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
count_qa = (df['revenue'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {count_qa}")

# Check the actual population: completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]
print(f"Number of LOYAL completed orders: {len(loyal_completed)}")
print(f"Customer segments in LOYAL completed orders: {loyal_completed['customer_segment'].unique()}")
print(f"Statuses in LOYAL completed orders: {loyal_completed['status'].unique()}")

# Check if there are other segments in the data
all_segments = df['customer_segment'].unique()
print(f"All customer segments in data: {all_segments}")

# Check if there are other statuses
all_statuses = df['status'].unique()
print(f"All statuses in data: {all_statuses}")

# Remove QA orders
loyal_completed_clean = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed_clean['revenue'].mean()

# Output
print(f"Number of LOYAL completed orders after filtering QA: {len(loyal_completed_clean)}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}")"}
